test_title: PYST 78: SSC GD Constable - English (Held On - 29 Feb, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: english
question: Four sentences are given, out of which three have all correct spellings. Choose the sentence with the incorrect spelt word/ words.

options.text: His life had reduced itself to the functions of weaving and hoarding, without any contemplation of an end toward which the functions tended.
When Abe's car pulled up ahead of them the east was crayoned red and yellow, promising a sultry day.
I knew he would take an interest in this kind of business, and throw in the fancy touches.
I resisted all the way: a circumstance which grately strengthend the bad opinion Bessie and Miss Abbot were disposed to entertain of me.

solution: The correct answer is **Option 4**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word "**grately**" is incorrectly spelt; the correct spelling is "**greatly**." • "**Greatly**" means to a great extent; very much. (बहुत अधिक) • • **Example:** She was greatly relieved to hear the good news. • The word "**strengthend**" is also incorrectly spelt; the correct spelling is "**strengthened**." • "**Strengthened**" means to make or become stronger. (मजबूत किया) • • **Example:** The new evidence** strengthened **their case significantly. Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Option 1: "His life had reduced itself to the functions of weaving and hoarding, without any contemplation of an end toward which the functions tended."** – This sentence is correctly spelt. (इस वाक्य में सभी शब्द सही तरीके से लिखे गए हैं।) • **Option 2: "When Abe's car pulled up ahead of them the east was crayoned red and yellow, promising a sultry day."** – This sentence is correctly spelt. (इस वाक्य में सभी शब्द सही तरीके से लिखे गए हैं।) • **Option 3: "I knew he would take an interest in this kind of business, and throw in the fancy touches."** – This sentence is correctly spelt. (इस वाक्य में सभी शब्द सही तरीके से लिखे गए हैं।) 39:Tbe0, The correct answer is: **Option 3**.
